ios.desc:
Wildex — Your Real-Life Nature Collection

Turn every walk into a wildlife treasure hunt. Point your camera at any plant, animal, bird, bug, insect, snake, spider, butterfly, frog, mushroom, or tree — Wildex identifies it instantly and adds it to your personal collection. Like a real-life Pokedex for nature.

SNAP & IDENTIFY
• Instant AI identification — just point your camera
• Works on plants, animals, birds, bugs, insects, spiders, snakes, frogs, butterflies, mushrooms, trees, and more
• Get species name, fun facts, and rarity info in seconds
• Identify species on hikes, in your backyard, at the park — anywhere in nature

COLLECT THEM ALL
• Every species you find gets a beautiful holographic collection card
• Species are ranked by rarity — common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary
• Build the ultimate nature collection and discover what lives around you
• Track where and when you found each species on your personal map

COMPETE & CLIMB
• Earn XP for every new species — rare finds = massive points
• Climb local and global leaderboards
• Complete daily quests for bonus XP
• Maintain your streak and watch your collection grow
• See how your collection stacks up against friends

WHAT CAN WILDEX IDENTIFY?
• Plants — flowers, trees, mushrooms, succulents, cacti, ferns, and weeds
• Animals — mammals, reptiles, frogs, salamanders, fish, and more
• Birds — scan any bird and get an instant species ID
• Bugs & Insects — spiders, butterflies, beetles, caterpillars, moths, ants, and dragonflies
• Snakes — identify any snake species from a photo
• And thousands more species across every biome on Earth

Whether you're a nature lover, a curious hiker, a dog walker wondering "what plant is that?", or a parent exploring the outdoors with kids — Wildex is the only nature identifier you need.

100% free to start. Works anywhere there's nature — your backyard counts.

quotes.text:
Dear HN,

My wife and I both love nature and have always wanted a Pokémon go style app, to collect and learn about different species we find.

All the usual species identifying apps were didn’t feel fun enough, so we designed and built one together!

Would love for you guys to give it a try and share any thoughts you have.
